description: State the shot cut yourself: which clips form one shot, what it is called, which scene it plays in. This is the counterpart to lab_shots_ableiten — that one groups by the scene the clips already name, this one is for the judgement no field carries. Costs nothing. Use it where derivation cannot reach: ingested footage has no shotlist by nature, and a sequence whose clips name no scene would come out of a derivation as one shot per clip — the timeline under another name. It is also the ONLY way to build the 'movement' layer (arcs over shots); the derivation only ever writes 'shot'. REPLACES the whole level in one go: every shot of this `rung` that you do not list is gone. The other level is untouched — recutting shots does not throw the arcs away. Refusals happen BEFORE anything is written: an unknown clip_id, or the same clip in two shots of one level. A half-set shot list looks like a result and is none. Read lab_shots first and send its clip_ids back — a shot binds clip identities, not time ranges, so shortening a clip later simply shortens the shot. What you set here counts as handwork: a later lab_shots_ableiten leaves these shots alone and does not touch their clips.

rung.description: Which level to replace. 'shot' (the default) is one take; 'movement' groups shots into arcs. Independent layers over the same clips — writing one never touches the other

seq_id.description: Sequence id (from lab_create_sequence/lab_list_sequences) — positive integer as string

shots.description: The whole level, in order. The order here IS the order of the shots

beschreibung.description: Longer note about the shot. Optional

clip_ids.description: The clips that form this shot, as lab_shots and lab_timeline_apply report them. They need not be adjacent — one location cut into twice is one shot, and the answer marks it `zusammenhaengend: false` instead of hiding it

eltern_id.description: For rung 'shot': the id of the movement it belongs to (from lab_shots with rung 'movement'). Leave it out for a movement

scene_ref.description: Scene this shot plays in, if you know it

titel.description: What this shot is, in the cutting room's words. Shown in the editor's shot band

name: lab_shots_setzen
title: Set Shot Cut
